name: plan-coverage-change-boundary
body:
Scope boundary (prose; assessed by review): this change-set changes ONLY (a) the plan-verify derived-coverage scope computation and the tests that pin it, and (b) the plan-review agent prompt `opencode-suite/agents/plan-review.md` (`requirements.requirement.plan-review-deterministic-and-minimal`) — the agent-side reconciliation: verify coverage DETERMINISTICALLY via the binary's delta coverage check and treat any gap as blocking feedback, then review each plan node semantically against the spec delta with a less-code bias (removing a solution node / `implemented-by` edge normally yields a `deletes` task, else the keep/modify must be justified in a task note). The plan-review prompt is product source (`solution.constraint.suite-is-product-source`), embedded via `include_str!`; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` remain consumer artifacts and are not edited here.

It does NOT change the planned-node realization gate, the feedback-resolution gate, the durable node/edge write surface, the suite tools (`apg_plan_*` — including `apg_plan_phases`'s own project/requirement scoping), or `apg plan verify`'s CLI/exit surface; the coverage refusal keeps naming the owning solution node and the uncovered code FQN.
